items.title: Objection (Einspruch) against the vehicle tax assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' given, so posting day = 20.11.2026. This is a tax matter (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer, Hauptzollamt), so § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO / § 108 Abs. 3 AO apply: delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (20.11 + 4 days, counting calendar days: 21.11 Sat, 22.11 Sun, 23.11 Mon, 24.11 Tue = day 4), i.e. Tuesday 24.11.2026. This is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, so no shift of the delivery day is needed. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 108 Abs. 1 AO): the day of delivery itself is not counted, and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 24.12.2026 (a Thursday, not a holiday in NW or at the Hauptzollamt's seat), so no further shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is necessary.
